s: Mi hem hareuyim litqiat shopar ubo t' seipim: mi shechetzyo ebed vechetzyo ben chorin tzarik sheyyitqa lo ben chorin lehotzio, abal eno yotze bitqiato shel atzmo, lepi shetztzad cherut shebbo nitchayyeb betesha teqiot shelemot bekashruto, veim yitqa beatzmo tehe kol teqia uteqia sheyyotzet mippiv chetzyah pesula mechamat tzad abdut shebbo:

Ap al pi shehannashim peturot, mikkol maqom im ratzu litqoa beatzman hareshut beyadan. Veap al pi shehatteqia beyom tob bechinnam asura middibre soperim, mikkol maqom kede laasot nachat ruach lannashim hittiru lahen issur qal kazeh sheen bo apillu mishshum shebut gamur ella mishshum ubdin dechol. Veken adam achar sheyyatza kebar yede chobato muttar litqoa lahen. Umuttar lehotzi hashshopar lirshut harabbim kede litqoa lahen. Ukebar nitbaer besiman y"[z] shennahagu hannashim lebarek al kol mitzvot aseh shehazzeman gerama, al ken gam kan yebareku hannashim leatzman, abal anashim lo yebareku lahen im kebar yatzeu yede chobatam veenan toqeim raq bishbil hannashim, lepi shehi beraka lebattala, shehare hannashim beatzman enan chayyabot bibraka zo sheyyebarek zeh lehotzian yede chobatan bibraka zo, ella shellahen beatzman hareshut beyadan lebarek mittaam shennitbaer sham, abal acher lamma yebarek bechinnam. Veharotzeh litqoa lannashim ulebarek lahen — yitqa lahen qodem sheyyishma hatteqiot bebet hakkeneset, o sheyyekavven belibbo shello latzet yede chobato bitqiot shel bet hakkeneset, deaz yakol lebarek bishbil atzmo sheadayin lo yatza yede chobato. Veap al pi sheholek lahen litqoa bebattehen vechozer lebet hakkeneset veshomea hatteqiot dimummad sheal seder habberakot — eno tzarik lachazor ulebarek alehem, veap al pi shehipsiq bahalika lebet hakkeneset ben birkato litqiot ellu, shehare apillu im hipsiq besicha benetayim eno tzarik lachazor ulebarek mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tqtz"b:

Mi shehu muddar hanaa mechabero sheamar qonam sheani neheneh mippeloni — muttar chabero litqoa lo teqia shel mitzva, sheen zo chashuba hanaa kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"v. Vehu sheyyitqa lo chabero meatzmo, abal hu lo yomar lachabero sheyyitqa lo, dekevan sheasar chabero hanaato alayv — asur lo laasot chabero shaliach litqoa lo:
Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheasar hanaat chabero alayv, abal im asar teqiat chabero alayv sheamar qonam teqiato shel peloni alayv — asur lo lishmoa apillu teqia shel mitzva mechabero:

Kol hammitzvot en adam yotze bahem yede chobato ella im ken nitkavven baasiyyatan shehu oseh dabar zeh leshem mitzva kemo shennitbaer besiman s'. Lepikak, hammitasseq bitqiat shopar kede lehitlammed — lo yatza yede chobato. Veken hashshomea min hammitasseq — lo yatza, ap al pi shenitkavven hashshomea leshem mitzva, kevan shehattoqea lo nitkavven im ken teqia pesula shama:
Veken hattoqea leshorer velo nitkavven litqiat mitzva — lo yatza. Veken hashshomea mimmennu — lo yatza:

Im nitkavven hattoqea lehotzi et hashshomea yede chobato velo nitkavven hashshomea latzet yede chobato bishmia zo, o shennitkavven hashshomea latzet yede chobato velo nitkavven hattoqea lehotzi et hashshomea ella taqa leatzmo — lo yatza hashshomea yede chobato, ad sheyyitkavvenu shenehem shomea umashmia. Mi shettaqa venitkavven lehotzi kol mi sheyyishma teqiato veshama hashshomea venitkavven latzet yede chobato, ap al pi sheen hattoqea mitkavven liploni zeh sheshshama teqiato veeno yodeo kelal, ap al pi ken yatza hashshomea yede chobato, shehare hattoqea nitkavven lehotzi lekol mi sheyyishmeennu. Lepikak mi shehaya mehallek badderek o yosheb betok beto veshama teqiot mishsheliach tzibbur — yatza im nitkavven latzet bishmia zo, shehare hashsheliach tzibbur hu mitkavven lehotzi et harabbim yede chobatan bitqiato:

Mi sheshshama teqiat mitzva veachar kak nistappeq lo im nitkavven latzet bishmiato — tzarik litqoa lo shenit missapeq. Abal mi shehaya mehallek veamad kede lishmoa hatteqiot mishsheliach tzibbur veachar kak nistappeq lo im nitkavven latzet bishmiato — en tzarik litqoa lo shenit, dekevan sheamad mehalikato chazaqa shennitkavven latzet yede chobato:

Mi shebba lebet hakkeneset kede lishmoa hatteqiot mishsheliach tzibbur velatzet yede chobato im hatztzibbur, ap al pi shebbeshaa sheshshama lo haya lo shum kavvana ella shama setam — yatza, lepi shehu nigrar achar machashabto harishona shebba lebet hakkeneset kede latzet yede chobato. Abal mi shebba lebet hakkeneset bistam, shello nitkavven bebiato kede latzet yede chobato bishmiat hatteqiot mehashsheliach tzibbur, veachar kak shama bistam belo shum kavvana — lo yatza, shemmitzvot tzerikot kavvana kede latzet bahen yede chobatan:
